blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gymnastics Association of the Philippines president Cynthia Carrion is cutting short her Asian Games stint after her husband died of cancer on Monday. Carrion said she would fly back to the Philippines on Monday night, leaving the national gymnasts as they continue their campaign in Aichi-Nagoya. “If you don’t see me around, I’m going home today,” Carrion said in a video released by POC media. “I’m supposed to be here all the time for my athletes, but I cannot do it because my husband just died today with […]...
